tools.name: news_search
tools.description: Latest news articles on any topic, newest first, with source, date, link and summary (Bing News, GDELT as backup). For current events, company news and what is happening now. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: hacker_news
tools.description: Top, new or best Hacker News stories, or search stories by keyword. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: rss_read
tools.description: Read an RSS or Atom feed as JSON items. (cost: 1 credit)

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "news_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
